## About
Circle Auto Body is a body shop at 26 Thorndike Street in Everett. Our team can service all your needs from the unpleasant circumstance of an auto accident to a vehicle restoration, and we do mechanical repair too. We also paint motorcycles.
All insurances are accepted, and we can guide you with your claims paperwork. We can arrange towing and vehicle delivery, and we have a car rental service so you are not stuck without a ride. We paint with eco-friendly waterborne paints in SprayBake spray booths.
We serve Everett and nearby towns like Charlestown, Somerville, Medford, Malden and Revere. Our customers have given us a 4.8 rating from 44 reviews on Google.

## Services
- Accident work and restoration: We service all your needs after an auto accident, up to a full vehicle restoration.
- Free estimates: Bring your car in and we will give you an estimate at no cost.
- Painting for cars and motorcycles: Waterborne paint applied in SprayBake spray booths, for cars and motorcycles.
- Mechanical repair: Light mechanical work, tune ups, suspension, and shocks and struts.
- Paintless dent removal: Dent work without repainting the panel.
- Car rental: A rental car for your convenience while your car is being repaired.
- Towing and delivery: We can arrange to have your car towed to the shop and delivered.

## FAQ
Q: What do you need from me to process my claim?
A: The name of the insurance company paying the repair bill, the claim number, and an insurance company contact name and phone number.

Q: What do I need to rent a car?
A: A valid driver's license, a credit card, and your claim number. Rental agencies ask for a credit card for security even if the insurance company is paying.

Q: Can I come in after hours?
A: Yes. After hour appointments are available, so give us a call to set one up.
